verses.text: As dem near Jerusalem, for Bethphage and Bethany, by di Mount of Olives, e send two of im disciples,
talk to dem say, “Go di village wey dey opposite una. As una enter am, at once una go see young donkey wey dem tie, wey nobody don sit on before. Loose am, bring am come.
If anybody ask una, ‘Why una dey do this?’ talk say, ‘Lord need am;’ and at once e go send am back come here.”
Dem go, find young donkey wey dem tie for door outside for open street, and dem loose am.
Some of di people wey stand there talk to dem say, “Wetin una dey do, dey loose di young donkey?”
Dem talk to dem just as Jesus talk, and dem let dem go.
Dem bring di young donkey come meet Jesus, throw dem clothes on am, and Jesus sit on am.
Plenty people spread dem clothes for di road, and others cut leafy branches from di farms spread for di road.
Di people wey dey go for front and di ones wey dey follow shout, “Hosanna! Blessed be di one wey dey come for di name of di Lord!
Blessed be di kingdom of our papa David wey dey come for di name of di Lord! Hosanna for di highest!”
Jesus enter Jerusalem, and enter di temple. As e don look everything round, because e don reach evening, e go out go Bethany with di 12.
Di next day, as dem come out from Bethany, hunger catch am.
As e see fig tree from far wey get leaves, e go see if e fit find something on am. As e reach am, e no find anything except leaves, because e no be di season for figs.
Jesus talk to di tree say, “Make nobody ever chop fruit from you again!” and im disciples hear am.

Dem come Jerusalem, and Jesus enter di temple, begin throw out di people wey dey sell and di people wey dey buy for di temple, and e turn over di tables of di money changers and di seats of di people wey dey sell doves.
E no allow anybody carry container pass through di temple.
E teach, talk to dem say, “E no dey write say, ‘Dem go call my house house of prayer for all di nations’? But una don make am place wey robbers dey hide!”
Di chief priests and di scribes hear am, and dem dey look for way to destroy am. Because dem fear am, because all di crowd dey shock for im teaching.
When evening reach, e go out of di city.
As dem dey pass for morning, dem see di fig tree wey don dry from di roots.
Peter remember, talk to am say, “Rabbi, look! Di fig tree wey you curse don dry.”
Jesus answer dem, “Make una get faith for God.

Because na true I dey tell una, anybody wey talk to this mountain say, ‘Lift up and throw yourself inside di sea,’ and e no doubt for im heart, but e believe say wetin e talk dey happen; e go get anything wey e talk.
So I dey tell una, everything wey una pray and ask for, believe say una don receive am, and una go get am.
Any time una dey stand dey pray, forgive, if una get anything against anybody; so that una Papa God wey dey heaven go forgive una transgressions too.
But if una no forgive, una Papa God wey dey heaven no go forgive una transgressions too.”
Dem come Jerusalem again, and as e dey waka for di temple, di chief priests, di scribes, and di elders come meet am,
and dem begin talk to am say, “Na which authority you take dey do these things? Or who give you this authority to do these things?”
Jesus talk to dem say, “I go ask una one question, una answer me, and I go tell una na which authority I dey take do these things.
John baptism, e come from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”
Dem dey reason among dem, dey talk say, “If we talk say, ‘From heaven,’ e go talk say, ‘Den why una no believe am?’
But if we talk say, ‘From men’”—dem fear di people, because all dey hold say John na real prophet.
Dem answer Jesus, “We no know.” Jesus talk to dem say, “Me too, I no go tell una na which authority I dey take do these things.”
E begin talk to dem with parables. “One man plant vineyard, put fence round am, dig pit for di winepress, build tower, rent am to farmers, and go another country.
When di time reach, e send one servant to di farmers to collect some of di fruit of di vineyard from di farmers.
Dem catch am, beat am, and send am go with empty hand.
Again e send another servant to dem; and dem throw stones for am, wound am for head, and send am go with shame.
Again e send another; and dem kill am; and plenty others, dem beat some, and dem kill some.
So e still get one, im beloved son, e send am last to dem, dey talk say, ‘Dem go respect my son.’
But those farmers talk among demself say, ‘This na di heir. Come, make we kill am, and di inheritance go be our own.’
Dem catch am, kill am, and throw am out of di vineyard.
So wetin oga of di vineyard go do? E go come destroy di farmers, and give di vineyard to others.
Una never even read this Scripture: ‘Di stone wey di builders reject don become di head of di corner.
Na from di Lord this come. E marvelous for our eyes’?”
Dem try catch am, but dem fear di crowd; because dem know say na against dem e talk di parable. Dem leave am, go away.
Dem send some of di Pharisees and of di Herodians to am, so that dem go trap am with im words.

When dem come, dem ask am, “Teacher, we know say you dey honest, and you no dey favor anybody; because you no dey show partiality, but you dey teach di way of God truthfully. Di law allow make person pay tax to Caesar, or no?
We go pay, or we no go pay?” But e know dem hypocrisy, e talk to dem say, “Why una dey test me? Bring denarius come make I see am.”
Dem bring am. E ask dem, “Na who image and writing be this?” Dem talk to am, “Na Caesar own.”
Jesus answer dem, “Give Caesar wetin be Caesar own, and give God wetin be God own.” Dem marvel well well for am.
Some Sadducees, wey dey talk say resurrection no dey, come meet am. Dem ask am,
“Teacher, Moses write for us say, ‘If man brother die, and e leave wife, and e no leave pikin, make im brother take di wife, and raise pikin for im brother.’
Seven brothers dey. Di first marry wife, and e die without leaving pikin.
Di second marry am, and e die, e no leave pikin. Di third too;
and di seven all marry am and none leave pikin. Last of all di woman die too.
For di resurrection, when dem rise, na who wife di woman go be among dem? Because di seven marry am.”
Jesus talk to dem say, “No be because una dey wrong, una no know di Scriptures, and una no know di power of God?
Because when dem rise from di dead, dem no dey marry, and dem no dey give dem for marriage, but dem be like angels for heaven.
But about di dead, say dem dey rise; una no read for di book of Moses, about di burning bush, how God talk to am say, ‘I na di God of Abraham, di God of Isaac, and di God of Jacob’?
E no be God of di dead, but of di living. So una dey very wrong.”
One of di scribes come, hear dem dey argue together. As e know say Jesus don answer dem well, e ask am, “Which commandment dey greatest of all?”
Jesus answer, “Di greatest na, ‘Hear, Israel, di Lord our God, di Lord na one:
you go love di Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ Na di first commandment.
Di second be like am, ‘You go love your neighbor as yourself.’ No other commandment dey wey greater pass these.”
Di scribe talk to am say, “True, Teacher, you don talk well say e be one, and no other dey except am,
and to love am with all di heart, with all di understanding, and with all di strength, and to love im neighbor as imself, important pass all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
When Jesus see say e answer wisely, e talk to am say, “You no far from God Kingdom.” Nobody dare ask am any question again after that.
As Jesus dey teach for di temple, e answer say, “How di scribes dey take talk say Christ na David son?
Because David imself talk by Holy Spirit, ‘Di Lord talk to my Lord say, Sit for my right hand, until I make your enemies di footstool for your feet.’
So David imself dey call am Lord, den how e take be im son?” Di common people dey happy to hear am.
For im teaching e talk say, “Beware of di scribes, wey like to waka with long robes, and love greetings for di marketplaces,
and di best seats for di synagogues, and di best places for feasts:
di ones wey dey take widows house dem, and dey make long prayers for show. These ones go receive greater condemnation.”
E sit down opposite di treasury, and see how di crowd dey put money inside di treasury. Plenty rich people put plenty.
One poor widow come, and e put two small brass coins, wey be like one quadrans.
E call im disciples come, talk to dem say, “Na true I dey tell una, this poor widow give more pass all di people wey dey give for di treasury,
because dem all give from dem plenty, but di widow, from im poverty, give everything wey e get to live on.”
As e dey go out of di temple, one of im disciples talk to am say, “Teacher, look di kind stones and di kind buildings!”
Jesus talk to am say, “You see these big buildings? Nobody go leave one stone on another here wey dem no go throw down.”
As e dey sit for Mount of Olives opposite di temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew ask am privately,
“Tell us, when these things go happen? Wetin be di sign say all these things dey about to happen?”
Jesus begin tell dem, “Make una careful make nobody lead una astray.
Plenty people go come for my name, dey talk say, ‘Na me!’ and dem go lead plenty people astray.
When una hear about wars and rumors of wars, no worry. Those things must happen; but di end never reach.
Because nation go rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. Earthquakes go dey for different places. Famine and trouble go dey. These things na di beginning of birth pains.
But make una watch out, because dem go deliver una go councils, and dem go beat una for synagogues. Una go stand before rulers and kings for my sake, as testimony to dem.
Di Good News must first dey preach to all di nations.
When dem lead una go and deliver una, no worry before, and no plan wetin una go talk, but talk anything wey dem go give una for that hour. Because no be una dey talk, but na di Holy Spirit.
Brother go deliver brother to death, and papa go deliver im pikin. Pikin dem go rise against dem papa and mama, and go make dem kill dem.
All men go hate una for my name sake, but di person wey endure reach di end, na im dem go save.
But when una see di abomination of desolation, wey Daniel di prophet talk about, standing wia e no suppose stand”—make di reader understand—“den make di people wey dey Judea run go di mountains,
make di person wey dey for di housetop no go down, and no enter go carry anything out of im house.
Make di person wey dey for di farm no go back to carry im cloak.
But sorrow dey for di women wey get belle and di ones wey dey breastfeed pikin dem for those days!
Pray say e no go happen for winter.
Because for those days, suffering go dey, wey no dey like am from di beginning of creation wey God create until now, and e no go ever dey again.
If di Lord no shorten di days, nobody go survive; but for di sake of di chosen ones wey e choose, e shorten di days.
Den if anybody tell una, ‘Look, Christ dey here!’ or, ‘Look, e dey there!’ no believe am.
Because false christs and false prophets go rise, and dem go show signs and wonders, so that dem fit lead astray, if e possible, even di chosen ones.
But una watch. Look, I don tell una everything before.
But for those days, after that suffering, di sun go dark, di moon no go give im light,
di stars go dey fall from di sky, and di powers wey dey for di heavens go shake.
Den dem go see di Son of Man dey come inside clouds with great power and glory.
Den e go send out im angels, and gather im chosen ones from di four winds, from di farthest part of di earth to di farthest part of di sky.
Now from di fig tree, learn this parable. When di branch don soft, and e don put out im leaves, una know say summer near;
so una too, when una see these things dey happen, know say e near, e dey di door.
Na true I dey tell una, this generation no go pass away until all these things happen.
Heaven and earth go pass away, but my words no go pass away.
But about that day or that hour nobody know, even di angels for heaven no know, and even di Pikin no know, na only Papa God know.
Watch, stay alert, and pray; because una no know when di time go reach.
E be like man wey dey travel go another country, wey leave im house, give authority to im servants, give each person im work, and e command di doorkeeper to keep watch.
So make una watch, because una no know when oga of di house go come, whether for evening, or midnight, or when cock crow, or for morning;
so that e no go come suddenly and meet una dey sleep.
Wetin I tell una, I tell everybody: Watch.”
E remain two days before di feast of Passover and di unleavened bread, and di chief priests and di scribes dey look for way to catch am by trick and kill am.
Because dem talk say, “No be during di feast, because riot fit start among di people.”

While e dey Bethany for Simon house, di man wey get leprosy, as e dey sit for table, one woman come with alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—e cost well well. E break di jar, and pour am on im head.
But some people vex among demself, dey talk say, “Why dem waste this ointment?
Because dem fit don sell am for more than 300 denarii and give di money to di poor.” So dem dey grumble against di woman.
But Jesus talk say, “Leave di woman. Why una dey trouble am? E don do good work for me.
Because una get di poor with una always, and any time una want, una fit do dem good; but una no go get me always.
E don do wetin e fit do. E don anoint my body before time for burial.
Na true I dey tell una, any place wey dem preach this Good News for all di world, dem go talk about wetin this woman do too, as memorial for am.”
Judas Iscariot, wey be one of di 12, go meet di chief priests, so that e go deliver am to dem.
When dem hear am, dem happy, and promise to give am money. E dey look for good chance to deliver am.
For di first day of unleavened bread, when dem dey sacrifice di Passover, im disciples ask am, “Wia you want make we go prepare so that you fit chop di Passover?”
E send two of im disciples, talk to dem say, “Go enter di city, and one man wey carry pitcher of water go meet una. Follow am,
and any place wey e enter, tell oga of di house, ‘Di Teacher talk say, Wia my guest room dey, wia I go chop di Passover with my disciples?’
Imself go show una one big upper room wey dem don arrange and e ready. Prepare for us there.”
Im disciples go out, enter di city, and find things as e talk to dem, and dem prepare di Passover.
When evening reach, e come with di 12.
As dem dey sit dey chop, Jesus talk say, “Na true I dey tell una, one of una go betray me—di one wey dey chop with me.”
Dem begin sorrow, and ask am one by one, “No be me?” And another talk say, “No be me?”
E talk to dem say, “Na one of di 12, di one wey dey dip with me for di dish.
Because di Son of Man dey go, just as e dey write about am, but sorrow go dey for that man wey dem go use betray di Son of Man! E go better for that man if dem never born am.”
As dem dey chop, Jesus take bread, and when e don bless am, e break am, give dem, and talk say, “Take, chop. This na my body.”
E take di cup, and when e don thank God, e give dem. Dem all drink from am.
E talk to dem say, “This na my blood of di new covenant, wey dem pour out for plenty people.
Na true I dey tell una, I no go drink di fruit of di vine again, until di day wey I go drink am new for God Kingdom.”
When dem don sing hymn, dem go out go Mount of Olives.
Jesus talk to dem say, “All of una go stumble because of me tonight, because e dey write, ‘I go strike di shepherd, and di sheep go scatter.’
But after dem don raise me up, I go waka go before una to Galilee.”
But Peter talk to am say, “Even if all of dem stumble, I no go stumble.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Na true I dey tell you, today, even this night, before cock crow two times, you go deny me three times.”
But e talk more strongly, “If I must die with you, I no go deny you.” Dem all talk di same thing.
Dem reach one place wey dem call Gethsemane. E talk to im disciples say, “Sit here, while I pray.”
E take Peter, James, and John with am, and begin to dey very troubled and distressed.
E talk to dem say, “My soul dey very sorrowful, reach death. Stay here, and watch.”
E go small forward, fall for ground, and pray say if e possible, make di hour pass from am.
E talk say, “Abba, Papa God, everything possible for you. Remove this cup from me. But no be wetin I want, but wetin you want.”
E come and find dem dey sleep, talk to Peter say, “Simon, you dey sleep? You no fit watch for one hour?
Watch and pray, so that una no enter temptation. Di spirit really want, but di flesh weak.”
Again e go, pray, dey talk di same words.
Again e come back, find dem dey sleep, because dem eyes heavy well well; and dem no know wetin to answer am.
E come di third time, talk to dem say, “Una still dey sleep and dey rest? E don do. Di hour don reach. Look, dem don betray di Son of Man give sinners hand.
Get up, make we go. Look, di one wey dey betray me don near.”
At once, as e still dey talk, Judas, one of di 12, come, and with am plenty people wey carry swords and clubs, from di chief priests, di scribes, and di elders.
Di one wey betray am don give dem sign, talk say, “Anybody wey I go kiss, na im be that. Catch am, lead am go carefully.”
When e reach, at once e go meet am, talk say, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kiss am.
Dem put hands on am, catch am.
But one of di people wey stand near draw im sword, strike di servant of di high priest, cut im ear off.
Jesus answer dem, “Una come out, like say na against robber, with swords and clubs to catch me?
I dey with una every day for di temple dey teach, and una no arrest me. But na so that di Scriptures go fulfill.”
Dem all leave am, run.
One young man follow am, wear only linen cloth round im naked body. Di young men grab am,
but e leave di linen cloth, run from dem naked.
Dem lead Jesus go di high priest. All di chief priests, di elders, and di scribes gather with am.
Peter follow am from far, until e enter di high priest courtyard. E dey sit with di officers, dey warm imself for di fire light.
Di chief priests and di whole council dey look for witnesses against Jesus so that dem go kill am, and dem no find any.
Because plenty give false testimony against am, but dem testimony no agree with each other.
Some stand up, give false testimony against am, dey talk say,
“We hear am talk say, ‘I go destroy this temple wey dem make with hands, and for three days I go build another wey dem no make with hands.’”
Even so, dem testimony no agree.
Di high priest stand up for middle, ask Jesus, “You no get answer? Wetin be this wey dem dey testify against you?”
But e keep quiet, and answer nothing. Again di high priest ask am, “You na Christ, Pikin of di Blessed One?”
Jesus talk say, “I AM. Una go see di Son of Man dey sit for di right hand of power, and e dey come with di clouds of di sky.”
Di high priest tear im clothes, talk say, “Why we still need witnesses?
Una don hear di blasphemy! Wetin una think?” Dem all condemn am say e deserve death.
Some begin spit for am, cover im face, beat am with fists, and talk to am say, “Prophesy!” Di officers slap am with dem palms.
As Peter dey di courtyard below, one of di high priest maids come,
and see Peter dey warm imself, e look am, talk say, “You dey with di Nazarene, Jesus, too!”
But e deny, talk say, “I no know, and I no understand wetin you dey talk.” E go out go di porch, and cock crow.
Di maid see am, begin tell di people wey stand there again, “This one na one of dem.”
But e deny again. After small time again di people wey stand there talk to Peter, “You truly na one of dem, because you na Galilean, and your speech show am.”
But e begin curse, and swear, “I no know this man wey una dey talk about!”
Di second time cock crow. Peter remember di words, how Jesus talk to am, “Before cock crow two times, you go deny me three times.” As e think about that, e cry.
At once for morning, di chief priests, with di elders and scribes, and di whole council, hold meeting, tie Jesus, carry am go, and deliver am to Pilate.
Pilate ask am, “You na di King of di Jews?” E answer, “Na you talk am.”
Di chief priests accuse am of plenty things.
Pilate ask am again, “You no get answer? Look how many things dem dey accuse you of!”
But Jesus no answer again, so tay Pilate marvel.
Now for di feast e dey release one prisoner to dem, di one wey dem ask for.
One man dey wey dem dey call Barabbas, wey dem tie with im fellow rebels, men wey commit murder for di rebellion.
Di crowd shout, begin ask am to do as e dey always do for dem.
Pilate answer dem, “Una want make I release di King of di Jews for una?”
Because e know say na jealousy make di chief priests deliver am.
But di chief priests stir up di crowd make e release Barabbas to dem instead.
Pilate ask dem again, “Den wetin I go do to di one wey una dey call di King of di Jews?”
Dem shout again, “Crucify am!”
Pilate talk to dem say, “Why, wetin bad e do?” But dem shout pass before, “Crucify am!”
Pilate want please di crowd, so e release Barabbas to dem, and after e don whip Jesus, e hand am over make dem crucify am.
Di soldiers lead am go inside di courtyard, wey be di Praetorium; and dem call di whole cohort together.
Dem wear am purple cloth, and dem weave crown of thorns, put am on im head.
Dem begin salute am, “Hail, King of di Jews!”
Dem strike im head with reed, spit on am, and dem kneel down dey bow to am.
When dem don mock am, dem remove di purple cloth from am, and put im own clothes on am. Dem lead am out to crucify am.
Dem force one man wey dey pass, wey dey come from di country, Simon of Cyrene, di papa of Alexander and Rufus, to go with dem, so that e carry im cross.
Dem bring am go di place wey dem dey call Golgotha, wey mean, “Di place of skull.”
Dem offer am wine wey dem mix with myrrh to drink, but e no take am.
Dem crucify am, dem share im clothes among dem, throw lots for dem to see wetin each go take.
Na di third hour, and dem crucify am.
Di writing wey show di accusation against am dey write for top: “Di King of di Jews.”
Dem crucify two robbers with am; one for im right hand, and one for im left hand.
Di Scripture fulfill, wey talk say, “Dem count am among transgressors.”
Di people wey dey pass blaspheme am, dey shake dem heads, dey talk say, “Ha! You wey go destroy di temple, and build am for three days,
save yourself, and come down from di cross!”
Di chief priests with di scribes too dey mock am among dem, talk say, “E save others; e no fit save imself.
Make Christ, di King of Israel, come down from di cross now, so that we go see and believe am.” Di ones wey dem crucify with am insult am too.
When di sixth hour reach, darkness cover di whole land until di ninth hour.
For di ninth hour Jesus shout with loud voice, talk say, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” wey mean, “My God, my God, why you don abandon me?”
Some of di people wey stand there, when dem hear am, talk say, “Look, e dey call Elijah.”
One run go, fill sponge with vinegar, put am for reed, give am to drink, dey talk say, “Leave am. Make we see if Elijah go come take am down.”
Jesus shout with loud voice, and give up im spirit.
Di veil of di temple tear for two from top reach bottom.
When di centurion wey stand opposite am see say e shout so and e die, e talk say, “Truly this man na God Pikin!”
Women dey too wey dey watch from far, among dem na Mary Magdalene, and Mary, mama of James di younger and of Joses, and Salome;
wey follow am and serve am when e dey Galilee; and plenty other women wey come up with am to Jerusalem.
When evening don reach, because na Preparation Day, wey be di day before Sabbath,
Joseph of Arimathaea, one respected council member, wey dey wait for God Kingdom too, come, and dey brave go meet Pilate, ask for Jesus body.
Pilate marvel say e don die already; e call di centurion, ask am if e don die since long time.
When e know am from di centurion, e give di body to Joseph.
E buy linen cloth, bring am down, wrap am inside di linen cloth, and put am inside tomb wey dem cut from rock. E roll stone against di door of di tomb.
Mary Magdalene and Mary, Joses mama, see wia dem put am.
When Sabbath don pass, Mary Magdalene, Mary, James mama, and Salome buy spices, so that dem go come anoint am.
Very early for di first day of di week, dem come di tomb as sun don rise.
Dem dey talk among demself say, “Who go roll away di stone from di door of di tomb for us?”
As dem look up, dem see say dem don roll di stone back, because e big well well.
As dem enter di tomb, dem see one young man dey sit for di right side, wear white robe; and dem shock.
E talk to dem say, “No shock. Una dey look for Jesus, di Nazarene, wey dem crucify. E don rise. E no dey here. Look di place wia dem put am!
But go, tell im disciples and Peter, ‘E dey go before una go Galilee. Una go see am there, as e talk to una.’”
Dem go out, run from di tomb, because shaking and amazement don catch dem. Dem no talk anything to anybody; because dem dey fear.
Now when e don rise early for di first day of di week, e first appear to Mary Magdalene, di one wey e don drive seven evil spirits out of.
E go tell di people wey dey with am before, as dem dey mourn and dey cry.
When dem hear say e dey alive, and say e don see am, dem no believe.
After these things e show imself for another form to two of dem, as dem dey waka go di country.
Dem go tell di rest. Dem no believe dem too.
After, e show imself to di eleven as dem dey sit for table; and e rebuke dem for dem unbelief and hard heart, because dem no believe di people wey see am after e don rise.
E talk to dem say, “Go enter all di world, and preach di Good News to all creation.
Anybody wey believe and dem baptize go be saved; but anybody wey no believe go be condemned.
These signs go follow di people wey believe: for my name dem go drive out evil spirits; dem go talk new languages;
dem go carry snakes; and if dem drink anything wey fit kill, e no go harm dem at all; dem go put hands on sick people, and dem go well.”
So after Lord don talk to dem, dem take am up go heaven, and e sit down for di right hand of God.
Dem go out, preach everywhere, Lord dey work with dem, and dey confirm di word with di signs wey follow. Amen.
